text:
Alex: Quick sync — Catalyst Inc asked for a short POC to prove inference latency + quality for their customer-support use case. They want 3 prioritized journeys and clear success criteria by EOW.
Priya: Good call. Proposed top 3 use cases: 1) Doc search + extract (answer span + cite), 2) Triage intent classifier -> routing, 3) Auto-summary + ticket draft. Keep them minimal to fit a 4-week POC.
Marco: Agree on the 3. For each we should define: endpoints, sample prompts/evals, data needed, and perf targets. I'll sketch a matrix.
Alex: Customer constraints: 1) must run in-hosted mode initially, with option to move to Dedicated; 2) budget ~ $8k for POC; 3) security team needs SSO + basic questionnaire answers.
Priya: Endpoint mapping (draft): /v1/query-docs (search+extract), /v1/triage (intent + routing), /v1/summarize (ticket draft). Each endpoint -> one model profile (e.g., redwood-1-small for triage, redwood-2 for extract/summaries).
Priya: Prompts: we'll collect 20 canonical prompts per journey + 100 eval examples for automated scoring. Metrics: precision@1 for extract, F1 for triage, ROUGE-L + human accept rate for summaries.
Marco: Success criteria (proposal): - Doc extract: mean exact-match >= 78% on eval set AND 95th percentile latency < 450ms. - Triage: macro-F1 >= 0.88 and route accuracy >= 92%. - Summaries: >85% pass rate in quick human review and 99th percentile latency < 700ms.
Jamie: Heads-up: security asks we'll need to answer: data retention policy, encryption at rest/in transit, SOC2 cert status, SSO / IdP support, audit logs retention. Also need to confirm whether PII will be sent to hosted API.
Priya: For PII we can offer client-side redaction example and recommend tokenization or hashing for identifiers. Will add a sample pipeline doc.
Alex: Pricing question from the buyer: can we do a time-boxed fixed POC fee instead of pay-as-you-go? They prefer predictability.
Marco: For pricing alternatives: 1) hosted usage estimate + credit cap; 2) flat POC fee that covers X tokens and support hours; 3) short Dedicated trial (engineering cost + minimum). Given $8k budget, recommend flat POC fee covering hosted usage + 8 hours SE time.
Priya: I'll draft an SOW: scope, endpoints, success criteria, data checklist, timeline (Week 0: onboarding, Week 1-2: integration + prompts, Week 3: evals, Week 4: review + handoff).
Alex: Customer wants a go/no-go decision criteria. Suggest we require at least 2 of 3 journeys meeting success metrics OR full acceptance on the primary journey (doc extract).
Marco: Risk log: 1) Data access delays (customer legal) -> contingency: use synthetic sanitized dataset. 2) SSO integration might push timeline -> contingency: temporary API keys + IP allowlist. 3) Model quality gap -> fallback to prompt engineering + quantization profile or swap model.
Jamie: Also request: customer fill security questionnaire v2 and provide SOC2 segment they need reviewed. I'll send the questionnaire link and add the answers we can pre-fill.
Priya: Action items: - Priya: Draft prompts + sample eval sets (due in 3 business days). - Marco: Draft SOW + success criteria doc (due in 2 business days). - Alex: Confirm POC fee and email proposal to Catalyst (today). - Jamie: Start security Q + verify SSO/IdP details (2 business days).
Alex: I'll loop in legal for the SOW and share payment terms. Can we get an internal quick review before I send?
Marco: Yep, I'll review. Priya, ping me when prompts are ready and I'll seed an eval harness.
Priya: Will do. I'll include example curl snippets for endpoints and a sample small dataset.
deploy-bot: deploy notification: integration-docs v1.2 pushed to sales-drive (link).
Alex: Thanks — let's reconvene Friday 11am to confirm final scope and sign-off. :thumbsup:
